2. VICTIM X THROUGH P.S.-BARWANI DIST-  BARWANI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI TARUN PAGARE, GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 (BY SHRI AJAY JAIN, ADVOCATE FOR RESPONDENT NO.2)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the fourth bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973 as he/she is implicated in connection with Crime No.810/2021 registered at Police Station - Barwani District - Barwani (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(N),
376(3) of IPC and Sections 5(L), 6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 09.11.2021.
Third application of the applicant has been dismissed on merits vide order dated 22.06.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.28192/2022.

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court and it is apparent that she was a consenting party.

Although his earlier application has been dismissed on the basis of her age, however, subsequently the mother and father of the prosecutrix have also been examined and they have stated that her age was 19 years in their examination-in-chief, which is also placed in record.
It is submitted that the applicant is lodged in jail since 09.11.2021 and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time, hence he be released on bail.
Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer.

Counsel for the respondent/objector has submitted that he has no objection if the bail of the applicant is allowed and affidavit of the prosecutrix has also been placed on record in support of this contention.

Having considered rival submissions and on perusal of the case-diary as also the documents filed along with the bail application, this Court finds force with the contention raised by the counsel for the applicant to allow the application.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on merits of the matter, the present application for grant of bail is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his/her appearance, as and when directed and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
C.c. as per rules.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE sumathi Anil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129645290/
